subject: RE: lunch
body_plain:
Great.  I'll pick you up.

-----Original Message-----
From: Vince.J.Kaminski@enron.com [mailto:Vince.J.Kaminski@enron.com]
Sent: Wednesday, December 12, 2001 9:53 AM
To: Cumberland, Shawn
Cc: vkaminski@aol.com
Subject: RE: lunch


Shawn,

Let's meet  on Wednesday, next week at noon.


Vince


    -----Original Message-----
   From:   "Cumberland, Shawn" <Shawn.Cumberland@ElPaso.com>@ENRON
   Sent:   Wednesday, December 12, 2001 9:47 AM
   To:     Kaminski, Vince J
   Subject:  RE: lunch

   Vince,

   Either day is fine for me.  What is your preference?

   Shawn

   -----Original Message-----
   From: Vince.J.Kaminski@enron.com [mailto:Vince.J.Kaminski@enron.com]
   Sent: Wednesday, December 12, 2001 9:29 AM
   To: Cumberland, Shawn
   Subject: RE: lunch


   Shawn,

   Sorry, I shall be in NYC on Tuesday. What about Wednesday or Thursday?

   Vince

       -----Original Message-----
      From:   "Cumberland, Shawn" <Shawn.Cumberland@ElPaso.com>@ENRON
      Sent:   Wednesday, December 12, 2001 9:23 AM
      To:     Kaminski, Vince J
      Subject:  lunch

      Vince:

      Good seeing you yesterday.

      Are we on for lunch next Tuesday at noon?

      Shawn
